digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows and dependency lockfile
propositions: setup-uv must be bumped from v9.0.0 to v10.0.0 across 19 pinned-SHA references in 11 workflow files, with v10's auto-cache-disable breaking change verified as non-breaking for rebar (all uses pass enable-cache: true explicitly)
botocore must be bumped from 1.43.69 to 1.43.70 and json-repair from 0.63.0 to 0.63.1 in uv.lock, with exact version pins enforced to match the reviewed scope
uv.lock format churn (revision 2→3, httpcore2 marker simplification) must be reproduced faithfully via regeneration with recent uv; pyproject.toml must remain unchanged
both dependabot PRs #129 and #130 must be consolidated into a single Gerrit change with one commit, DCO sign-off, and rebar-ticket trailer, landing only after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1
